resources.string: iOS-style widgets, one swipe away on Motorola\'s -1 screen
On your home screen, open Home settings → Swipe access (or Minus one screen) → select “AppFlash”.
First setup tip: If widgets don’t appear on the -1 screen, open Moto Launcher app info, tap Force stop, then return to the home screen.
This lets the widget shelf appear over your home screen.
Tap the button below to add widgets (Weather, Clock, Spotify, Calendar, etc.).
Your shelf is empty\nAdd a widget to get started.
